title: Proteomics shows a J-type head is alpaca bone

tellings.quote: I ran these all of these bone samples from the skull through this pipeline and they all came back identified as alpaca bone.

plain: Bone from the skull of one of the strange three-fingered mummies found in Peru, a type called a J-type head, turned out to be alpaca bone, according to an anonymous expert in proteomics, the study of proteins used here to tell which species a bone came from. The expert says they ran all the bone samples from the skull through their analysis pipeline and 'they all came back identified as alpaca bone', and points to a paper in the journal Nature on identifying ancient bones and to scans showing a likeness to an alpaca's braincase. If right, the head would be made from animal remains, not some unknown being.
